claim_boundary: Nagao scores and staged survival are scheduling heuristics, not rank evidence.
No section is evaluated and no point search or Selmer calculation occurs in this stage.
A low score cannot veto an unsearched fibre.
The known target scores are local positive-control measurements, not independent observations across repeated presentations.
Finalists are authorized only for bounded half-lattice recovery, never direct expensive point search.

geometry.presentation_role: nested coordinate-height search charts; never independent outcomes

next_gate.after_positive_recovery: run a complete same-minimal-curve residual 2-Selmer calculation before any expensive continuation toward rank 32
next_gate.forbidden_direct_transition: Nagao finalist -> unrestricted or giant point search
